question_scope: Issuer-published YTD parent-profit guidance/express chronology, not analyst consensus or all market expectations

sources.title: Tushare业绩预告forecast官方文档
sources.reviewed_facts_paraphrased: ann_date is announcement date; end_date is report period; net_profit_min/max are in10,000CNY, not rawCNY; first_ann_date is a separate field. Official documentation does not establish complete issuer revision vintages for the old response.
sources.role: Only cross-check existing5 vendor observations against the original issuer statements; do not turn missing vendor observations into absence of guidance.

sources.title: Tushare业绩快报express官方文档
sources.reviewed_facts_paraphrased: API separates announcement date and report period and reports monetary fields inCNY. Its generic n_income field name does not replace original-text certification of parent-attributable versus consolidated total-net-profit basis.
sources.role: The existing empty response remains an empty provider table, not proof that the issuer had no earlier express publication.

source_hierarchy: Official issuer original PDF, accounting scope/unit/printed precision and catalogue clock determine admission. The provider tables are cross-checks, not authoritative absence or vintage proofs.
date_policy: Date-only original publications are conservatively available at the next SSE session close; orders next session. This is deliberately distinct from instantaneous announcement trading or a certified vendor-arrival PIT archive.
research_budget_boundary: No additional Tushare calls. Search returned unrelated third-party articles; they were not used as research inputs or methodological evidence.
